label: For "Healthcare Compliance Evidence Collection Automation": Gather, classify, validate and organise the evidence that audits, accreditation and regulatory reviews require, so control owners attest to a complete, time-stamped binder instead of assembling it by hand. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the agent fill missing evidence.
